security_spec.violation_condition: OpenSBI M-mode trap handler executes SRET while mstatus.MDT=1 on an Smdbltrp system, causing MDT to be silently cleared as a side effect before the handler has re-established a reentrant state; a subsequent trap during this window then hits MDT=1 (unexpected trap) and triggers critical-error instead of being handled normally
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: SRET instruction executed while current privilege mode is M, without preceding explicit MDT save and subsequent restore; or M-mode MRET code path that writes MDT=1 before executing MRET (dead store since MRET unconditionally clears MDT on Smdbltrp systems)
security_spec.summary: MRET/SRET clearing MDT in M-mode is conditional on Smdbltrp; OpenSBI must guard MDT-dependent trap-return logic with Smdbltrp detection and account for silent MDT clearance on SRET/MRET side effects
